name: vertical-slider
title: Vertical Slider
blurb: Vertical carousel with up/down navigation buttons and side dot indicators.
description: Pre-built vertical carousel using embla-carousel with axis='y'. Displays image slides stacked vertically with up/down button navigation and dot indicator buttons positioned on the right.
use_when: Portfolio or timeline layouts where vertical scrolling is natural and expected.
avoid_when: Mobile devices—vertical carousels consume viewport height and limit visible content.
a11y: Up/down arrow buttons with icons. Dot buttons for direct slide access. No ARIA labels. Keyboard navigation via arrow keys.
